title: v0.7.0 command surface: /audit:<verb> split
desiredOutcome: Every action is its own /audit:<verb> command; no /audit:audit, and the plugin never suggests the non-existent bare /audit. Prompted by a user hitting 'Unknown command: /audit' because docs+recap emitted a command that does not exist.
summary: Root cause of the recurring 'Unknown command: /audit': plugin commands are namespaced /<plugin>:<cmd>, so the single audit.md was only reachable as /audit:audit and bare /audit never existed — yet every doc and the recap text emitted /audit. Split into seven verb commands sharing reference/orchestrator.md; fixed all handoff text. 193 selftest cases unchanged (hooks/scripts untouched).

tasks.title: Split orchestrator into /audit:<verb> commands
tasks.description: Move shared logic (preflight/lock/Execute-the-task/sign-off/resume) to reference/orchestrator.md; delete audit.md; add thin verb command files. Kills /audit:audit.

outcome.technical: 7 verb files + orchestrator.md; claude plugin validate passes with 11 commands.

tasks.title: Fix all /audit references -> /audit:<verb> (handoff text + docs)
tasks.description: The actual root-cause fix: the commands' recap/handoff text and all docs said '/audit run', '/audit phase' — commands that don't exist. Rewrite every reference to the correct /audit:<verb> so the plugin never suggests a non-working command again.

outcome.technical: grep-swept plugin + root docs; only path-like docs/audit and ./plugins/audit remain (not commands).
outcome.descriptive: Plugin output and docs now match reality.
